data.one_liner: Flutter plugin to check Android device root status and run shell commands.
data.what_it_do: Allows Flutter applications running on Android to check if the device is rooted or if su is available, and execute short shell commands. It is built on top of Topjohnwu libsu and Stericson Root Tools.
data.what_it_does: Allows Flutter applications running on Android to check if the device is rooted or if su is available, and execute short shell commands. It is built on top of Topjohnwu libsu and Stericson Root Tools.
use_when: You need to check if an Android device is rooted.
You need to execute short-running shell commands on Android.
avoid_when: You are building for non-Android platforms (iOS, Web, etc.).
You need to run long-running processes via shell commands.
strengths: Easy checking of root status and su availability.
Supports executing raw shell commands on Android.
weaknesses: Unsuitable for long-running shell processes as it may crash the app.
data.setup_notes: Android only; add the plugin dependency in pubspec.yaml.
